Priya Sharma: Weekly pulse for Verdant Labs — token footprint + throughput (QoQ / WoW). Quick summary: tokens WoW +22%, QoQ +35%; avg p50 45ms, p95 210ms (was 160ms last week); error rate 0.7% (baseline 0.12%); spend +40% QoQ. Onboarding: 80% seats active. Renewal: green but monitor spend spikes. Recommend enablement + batching tweaks and KV prefix caching for chat endpoints.

Maya Chen: Nice — can you drop the raw numbers and the two biggest drivers for the spend bump? :eyes:

Priya Sharma: Sure — raw snapshot below (last 7d vs prior week / last 90d vs prior 90d):
```
Tokens: 7d=9.2M (+22% WoW) | 90d=24.8M (+35% QoQ)
Requests: 7d=82k (+18% WoW)
Avg tokens/request: 112 (was 92)
Latency p95: 210ms (prev wk 160ms)
Errors: 0.7% (was 0.13%) -> spike Wed 18:00 UTC
Spend: $18.4k (90d avg $13.1k) -> +40% QoQ
Top driver: batch job @Wed 18:00 pushed 1.2M tokens in 30m (backend analytics)
Second driver: higher avg tokens/request after new multi-turn flow rollout
```

Liam O'Connor: I'll grab the autoscaling traces and instance-level GPU metrics for Wed 17:30-19:30. Likely queueing on the dedicated pool + cold cache on that path.

Carlos Vega: Yep that was us — we ran a nightly analytics export to test the new summary flow. Shouldn't have hit production endpoints, my bad. Any quick config recs to avoid this affecting user-facing latency?

Priya Sharma: No problem. Short term: throttle that export (use dedicated ingest tokens) or send to a non-prod model alias. For immediate relief: increase batching window for the /chat/generate route from 15ms -> 40ms and enable KV prefix caching on persona prompts. Expected impact: lower p95 by ~30-50ms and cut tokens/spend on repeated prefixes.

Maya Chen: Can we also push a temporary quota on that account's ingest token and notify their eng leads?

Priya Sharma: Yup — I can set a soft quota and a spend alert at $22k. I'll create an enablement session to walk their team through recommended burst controls.

cs-bot: Created ticket RN-7843: "Verdant Labs - Wed spike investigation + soft quota" assigned to Liam O'Connor. https://redwood.internal/tickets/RN-7843

Liam O'Connor: Assigned, will update ticket with traces and a short action checklist.

Maya Chen: Proposed enablement: Wed 11:00 PT (30m). @Carlos Vega can you confirm?

Carlos Vega: Confirmed — Wed 11:00 PT works. Thanks for the quick triage.

Priya Sharma: Follow-ups: 1) Liam posts trace + recommended autoscale knob changes in RN-7843 by EOD tomorrow; 2) I set soft quota + alert; 3) Enablement Wed 11:00 PT. If we see another >1M token burst in 30m we'll auto-escalate to infra.

Maya Chen: Sounds good. Low renewal risk but note to sales: highlight the spend bump and the next steps.

Carlos Vega: Appreciate it — will share internal note about moving analytics to staging.

Priya Sharma: Closing loop here after RN-7843 updates. Will post a short summary after Wednesday enablement. :white_check_mark:
